title: PROGRAM-ID. alone on its line, the name on the next (numbered)
shapes: 000200 PROGRAM-ID. / 000300     GLPOST. in a numbered member
asserts: The program-name is GLPOST, the next word after the PROGRAM-ID paragraph header, never the next line's sequence number.
